e030adce-d3d6-4638-b92a-11f6ff7fb67f@ufc.why: In the lightweight headliner, former title challenger Renato Moicano (21-7-1) faces rising contender Tom Nolan (11-1), who enters his first UFC main event on a five-fight winning streak, with both ranked fighters fighting to climb toward a 155-pound title shot. The co-feature pits the No. 6 against No. 7 in the women's bantamweight rankings, Yana Santos and Luana Santos, both on three-fight winning streaks, a bout that could reshuffle the division's top five.
e030adce-d3d6-4638-b92a-11f6ff7fb67f@ufc.know: A "title challenger" simply means a fighter who has previously fought for a championship belt, which is why Moicano's experience matters here. UFC rankings run from champion down through number 15 in each weight class, so beating a ranked opponent is how a fighter climbs toward contention. Fight Night cards like this one are the UFC's regular non-championship events, often used to spot the next wave of rising prospects before they reach the top 10.
